# Goal
Souji round 14 only. C1 calibration (lowest score 7): digest-bound evidence-cache eligibility; stale/legacy retained green must not be reused, and per-result measured revisions remain explicit. C2 operability: census refuses credential-store roots and aliases before enumeration; no credentials or operator-sweep access. Certification OFF; comprehensive recertification is not claimed.
# Contract
Lane: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin. Absolute paths required. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/<that path>. Leaf seats, no delegation, no commits, no builds/tests/linters/formatters/smoke runs. Only assigned write set plus own report; do not edit shared bookkeeping. Read lane AGENTS.md and relevant QUALITY criteria. Never open, copy, query, hash, quarantine, or modify anything under ~/.omp/agent/ EXCEPT reading RULES.md and skills; never launch omp CLI. Never open/edit/move/copy/commit census/operator-sweep-20261019/ or operator-sweep-20261018/. No sibling/fleet writes or runtime changes. L1 holds planner seat and integrates. All fixtures use /var/tmp with cleanup; no /dev/shm. No GUI, no credentials, no live removal. Read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first; install/upgrade helpful tools through official channels with full privilege and record tool/version/channel/reason. All seat reports explicitly separate code inspection from exercised evidence. Tool absence does not authorize omitted deliverables.

C1 executor owns tools/souji-evidence-cache.py and tests/fixtures/r14-evidence-cache.py. CLI --root DIR --record JSON; record {name,matched,measured_commit,dependencies:{relative-path:sha256}}. Exit 0 reusable, 1 stale/failed, 2 malformed/could-not-evaluate. Fail closed legacy/no dependencies, false matched, digest mismatch, missing/nonregular/symlink/escape dependencies. Named stable finding ids. --selftest self-invokes CLI isolated /var/tmp with expected ids. No proof of actual historical execution. C2 executor owns tools/souji-census.sh and tests/fixtures/r14-census-boundary.py; refuse root or compare paths overlapping credential-store lexical/canonical boundary (including ancestor roots and aliases) before git/find/du/content access. Never follow repo-root or .scratch symlinks into credential store. Fixtures use synthetic HOME under /var/tmp and command spies, never real credential store. Cite source row S038 (correction of S034) when appropriate after opening vendor timeout docs this round. S039 available for opened own-work evidence only after L1 runs.
